verdict.rationale: Trello is a SaaS product that ships AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any setting, policy, or control that keeps user data out of model training. The AI-writing Power-Up and the MCP server are adjacent AI features, not training-data controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
